headline: Kaz surges from 169th to 73rd on ARC-2

sections.text: Kaz gained 7.36 to reach 40.14, moving from 169th to 73rd on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The rise puts Kaz inside the board's top 100, a substantial climb in a field of 3,423 teams.
